_dropped_why: Deliberate omissions, recorded so that `harvest` can tell a considered drop from an accidental one — it fails if any source page is neither catalogued nor listed here.

dropped.websitedesign.com/tools/local-builder/in: The client-side LLM builder the owner asked to skip: downloads an ~800MB Llama model over WebGPU. Dropping it also removes the site's only esm.run dependency and its only WebGPU requirement.
dropped.websitedesign.com/guides/local-ai.html: Documents the skipped local-builder tool — nothing to point at once it is gone.
dropped.websitedesign.com/guides/hosting-economi: Byte-identical to local-ai.html (verified with diff — same title, same h1 'Understanding the Local AI Builder'). The hosting-economics content was never written, so there is nothing here to carry over.

_overlays_why: Subtitles disambiguate the five near-duplicate pairs identified in PLAN D7 — the pages are genuinely different tools, but their names do not say so. QA tier 1 marks anything with canvas, file upload, clipboard or IndexedDB: those need a real browser session, not a click-through.
